title: Existing Special Event Asset Audit Log
description: Live-verified contract for the existing single-layer append-only audit service used by Special Event Operations - Pedder. This is documentation, not a service-creation payload.

item.role: Existing audit service; do not provision replacement layers or tables

service.geometryRole: Point geometry records the observed location. DELETE records retain the last-known point.
service.storageModel: Audit events and geometry are appended. IsLastKnown and Workflow Manager delivery fields are administrative state updates; latest asset state is reconstructed by ChangeDateTime and OBJECTID.
service.latestStateRule: For each SourceObjectID, order by ChangeDateTime then OBJECTID and take the final row. A final DELETE means the source object is inactive.
service.idempotencyRule: DeliveryKey is deterministic and protected by the unique UX_Audit_DeliveryKey service index. The Notebook also queries candidate keys before append.

fields.name: SourceObjectID
fields.typeSource: inferred from name and source system
fields.purpose: Stable comparison key for the source row while source ObjectIDs remain stable

fields.name: SourceGlobalID
fields.purpose: Preferred durable source identity and provenance

fields.name: ChangeDateTime
fields.purpose: Source edit time when available; processing time for DELETE

fields.name: EditorUser
fields.purpose: Source editor when available, otherwise the current portal username

fields.name: IsLastKnown
fields.purpose: 1 on the most recent audit row for a source object; 0 on superseded rows

fields.name: WFMLastError
fields.purpose: Most recent Workflow Manager delivery error

fields.name: WFMCompletedDate
fields.purpose: UTC time the correlated Workflow Manager job closed

fields.name: WFMPayload
fields.purpose: Deterministic Notebook payload used for retry and reconciliation

source.hashingNote: The notebook hashes all non-system source attributes, including poststatus and staffagency, plus normalized geometry. DeliveryKey carries the resulting state hash because the audit layer has no dedicated attribute-hash field.

operationalNotes: The AAR app derives trails and point-in-time state client-side from ordered audit point records.
The Notebook reconstructs state from the latest audit row per SourceObjectID and the state hash embedded in DeliveryKey.
Source and audit capabilities, fields, editability, Web Mercator spatial references, and the unique DeliveryKey index were live verified on 2026-11-14.
Workflow Manager delivery state is durable and failed, pending, or processing rows are reconciled for up to five attempts.
